_comment: Scoped tsconfig for Stryker's typescript checker. Extends the project tsconfig but narrows `include` to only the production source files Stryker mutates (plus their direct dependencies under src/lib/) so pre-existing type errors in unrelated UI components (e.g. src/components/AlignmentDrilldown.tsx) don't block Stryker's dry-run compile. Test files are excluded — Stryker's TS checker validates that *mutated production code* still compiles, not that test fixtures match strict types under es2017 (vitest accepts es2018+ regex flags that strict tsc on es2017 rejects, and some test fixtures intentionally omit optional fields). Add new mutate targets here as the v1 scope grows. See docs/testing.md.
types_comment: Declared explicitly instead of relying on TypeScript's ambient @types auto-discovery. This config narrows `include` to server-side library code, and Stryker compiles it inside its own sandbox directory — where auto-discovery stopped resolving @types/node, failing the dry run with TS2591 'Cannot find name process' on db/client.ts and friends. Naming the types here is what the TS error message itself recommends, and it makes the program's ambient surface explicit rather than install-layout-dependent.
